edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the from argument into _transfer via _msgSender().
Public transfer uses msg.sender as the sending account.
manualswap authorization is a comparison of msg.sender against _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorization is a comparison of msg.sender against _feeAddrWallet1.
block.timestamp is compared against and written into the cooldown mapping inside _transfer.
block.timestamp is used directly as the swap deadline parameter.
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline in openTrading.
manualswap privilege depends on the stored _feeAddrWallet1 address.
manualsend privilege depends on the stored _feeAddrWallet1 address.
cooldown mapping is read and written with block.timestamp inside _transfer.
_maxTxAmount bounds the amount accepted by _transfer.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to to trigger fee and swap logic.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the swap and approve calls in swapTokensForEth.
uniswapV2Router is assigned and used for pair creation and liquidity in openTrading.
bots blacklist flags gate transfers inside _transfer.
_isExcludedFromFee flags bypass fee/swap branches in _transfer.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth, an external-call path, before balances are finalized by _tokenTransfer.
_transfer invokes sendETHToFee to push ETH out during the swap branch.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap that transfers ETH back into the contract.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to _feeAddrWallet2 before control returns.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to _feeAddrWallet1 before control returns.
openTrading forwards the contract ETH balance into the router addLiquidityETH call.
openTrading grants an unbounded pair approval to the router.
manualswap re-enters the swap routine using the whole contract balance.
manualsend re-enters ETH distribution to the fee wallets.
The router swap returns ETH to the contract, triggering the receive() hook during execution.
_transfer delegates the actual balance update to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to settle the transfer.
_transferStandard routes the team portion into _takeTeam.
_transferStandard routes the fee portion into _reflectFee.
_transferStandard performs sub/add arithmetic on _rOwned for sender, recipient and contract.
_takeTeam adds the scaled team reflection into _rOwned[address(this)].
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from the total reflection supply _rTotal.
_reflectFee adds tFee to the accumulated _tFeeTotal.
_transferStandard derives all amounts from _getValues arithmetic.
_getValues obtains the current reflection rate from _getRate for its divisions.
tokenFromReflection divides by the rate returned from _getRate.
balanceOf converts the stored reflection balance through tokenFromReflection.
transfer forwards execution into the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom executes _transfer with the sender and recipient arguments.
transferFrom reduces the allowance via _approve after the transfer.
approve delegates to the internal _approve writer.
_approve writes the new value into the _allowances mapping.
setCooldownEnabled rewrites cooldownEnabled and is protected by onlyOwner.
The onlyOwner modifier compares _owner with _msgSender() for setCooldownEnabled.
nonosquare writes caller-supplied addresses into the bots blacklist under onlyOwner.
delBot mutates the bots blacklist under onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership zeroes _owner, permanently disabling onlyOwner functions.
owner() returns the stored _owner value.
Constructor assigns the fixed _feeAddrWallet1 address.
Constructor assigns the fixed _feeAddrWallet2 address.
Constructor credits the whole reflection supply to the deployer in _rOwned.
Constructor indirectly initializes _owner through the Ownable base constructor.
openTrading stores the hardcoded router address into uniswapV2Router.
openTrading stores the created pair address into uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading sets tradingOpen under onlyOwner and a one-time require guard.
openTrading enables swapEnabled for automatic swaps.
openTrading lowers _maxTxAmount to 3000000 * 10**9.
The from parameter of _transfer drives address checks and balance updates.
The to parameter of _transfer drives bot, exclusion and cooldown branches.
The amount parameter feeds max-transaction and refund arithmetic.
tokenAmount is approved and passed to the external router swap.
amount is divided and pushed to the fee wallets in two external transfers.
Each bots_ array element is written as a blacklist flag.
notbot is written into the bots mapping to clear a blacklist entry.
The recipient argument of transfer flows into _transfer.
The amount parameter is subtracted from the allowance using SafeMath.
The owner parameter of _approve is validated and used as the allowance key.
contractTokenBalance is the token amount handed to swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is the ETH amount distributed by sendETHToFee.
The path array is supplied to the router swap call.
currentRate multiplies the team fee to obtain the reflection team amount.
rAmount is subtracted from the sender's reflection balance in _transferStandard.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to feed the _transfer routine; it is normalized into that function node.
The to parameter is consumed solely inside _transfer and merges into it.
The amount parameter is only used by _transfer arithmetic and bound checks.
tokenAmount is only passed to the router swap inside swapTokensForEth.
The amount parameter is split and transferred within sendETHToFee only.
The bots_ array is only iterated to write blacklist flags in nonosquare.
notbot is only used to clear a blacklist entry in delBot.
The recipient parameter is forwarded straight into _transfer by transfer.
The amount parameter is consumed by the allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
The owner parameter is only validated and used as the allowance key in _approve.
contractTokenBalance is computed in _transfer only to be forwarded to swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is read in _transfer only to be passed into sendETHToFee.
The path array is a transient swap argument used only in swapTokensForEth.
currentRate is a short-lived scaling factor used only inside _takeTeam.
rAmount is a temporary arithmetic value used only for the balance update in _transferStandard.
